paragraphs: Rav Manyumi son of Rav Nachumi (II).

He lived in Rav Ashi’s time and was a student of Ameimar. [Ketubot 69a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.69a.11) relates an exchange between Rav Ashi and Ameimar, and says that Ameimar, too, retracted: Rav Minyumi, son of Rav Nachumi, said, “I was standing before Ameimar and understood his view,” etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked passage gives Rav Minyumi son of Rav Nichumi as the person standing before Ameimar. The Gemara uses his report to explain Ameimar’s change of mind.

[Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2504&lang=en) discusses the difficulty of dating Minyumi alongside both Ameimar and earlier sages. Hyman titles this entry as a second bearer of the name and describes him as Ameimar’s student.
